description:
About HumanSignal 

 Real-world data is the competitive edge in AI.

 HumanSignal is a human data partner for companies building AI models and products. Our customers ship better AI, faster, because we partner with their researchers from real-world data creation to annotation to delivery.

 
We design and create datasets from scratch, recruit and manage the domain experts who evaluate model output, and run everything through our own platform, Label Studio, the open-source standard for data labeling and evaluation, used by over 1 million practitioners worldwide.

 
We specialize in the operationally complex: real-world data collection, multimodal pipelines, and multi-step workflows. Advanced ML and AI teams use our enterprise platform to run their own data factories, and our services team to extend their reach where in-house capacity runs out.

 
If you want to do work that materially shapes how the next generation of AI products gets built, we'd love to talk.

 Paid Performers and Voice Actors for an AI Research Study, $75/Hour 

 Earn $75/hour performing scripted scenes of everyday life. HumanSignal is recruiting actors, voice actors, improv performers, and live entertainers to take part in a paid research study. We record people doing everyday tasks and talking naturally so that researchers can study and improve how AI understands real human behavior. If you can take a script, make it sound like real conversation, and move naturally on camera, you can do this work.

 Compensation and logistics 

 
 Pay: $75/hour, paid within a week of each session.

 Type: Temporary, recurring gig work. Book one session or many.

 Training: Your first session is a paid four-hour training session at the full rate. You’ll learn the format through table reads and start recording scenes the same day.

 Residencies: Performers who stand out in their sessions may be invited to a residency for 40 hours/week. Residencies are by invitation based on performance and reliability, not guaranteed.

 Location: Virtual screening, then in-person recording at local studios.

 Dates: Now through December 2026. Weekday, evening, and weekend slots are available.

 
 What you will do 

 
 Perform scripted scenes of everyday household activities, like cooking, tidying, and folding laundry, in a staged home environment.

 Talk with a voice assistant as you work through each scene. The dialogue is scripted, but it needs to sound natural and unrehearsed, with room to make it your own.

 Bring the skills you already have. Cold reading, character work, and delivering lines while doing something with your hands are exactly what we’re looking for.

 
 Who we are looking for 

 
 Age 18 or older, located in or near Hoboken, NJ. Performers across the NYC metro area are welcome to apply. 

 Acting, improv, or performance experience at any level, including classes, student troupes, community theatre, open mics, voice work, or live entertainment. Aspiring and amateur performers are encouraged to apply.

 Comfortable being recorded on camera and audio for a full session.

 Reliable and on time for scheduled sessions.

 
 We welcome performers of all backgrounds and experience levels. A wide range of voices, speech patterns, and physical presence makes the research more representative of the real world.

 How it works 

 
 Apply with your name, email, phone number, and a link to sample work.

 We’ll reach out to schedule a 15-minute screening call on Zoom or Google Meet.

 If you’re a fit, book your first session, a paid four-hour training session. Evenings and weekends are available.

 Get paid within a week and book more sessions if you want them. Strong performers may be invited into a weekly residency.

 
 This is a research study 

 Every participant signs a plain-language research agreement before any recording. It states exactly how your recordings are used, and you can ask us anything about it before you commit.

 
 HumanSignal conducts research projects that record people doing everyday tasks in staged environments in order to develop and improve AI and machine learning technologies.

 We will not use your name, image, likeness, or voice to advertise, market, or promote any product or service without your separate written consent.

 Your recordings are not shared publicly, and they are not used to clone your face or voice or to create synthetic media of you.
